answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can transact, then publish every completed job on a public marble ledger that cannot be edited. Peers check the work and sign a beacon credential only after real delivery, so reputation accumulates slowly per identity. A saffron-tier badge is granted only after many verified jobs, unlocking higher-value work. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of stakes plus real work each, while honest agents earn the stake back.
